name: Omarchy Display Workspaces
author: nephilus (based on Omarchy)
description: Display workspace groups, manual profiles, and session-only layout previews

barWidget.description: The green display highlight follows the cursor. Displays update automatically when connected or disconnected; Detect displays refreshes without clearing presentation preferences. Right-click a display for compact Displays, Workspaces, and Profiles tabs. Choose advertised resolution/refresh rate, scale, and placement; move workspace cards between displays. Preview (20s), then Apply to keep changes for this session only. Save current captures a named live arrangement, never draft edits. Profiles match hardware before connectors and load manually into a draft; replacement and deletion require confirmation and exact backups. No automatic switching. Names, curated Nerd Font icons, and column order save separately and immediately. Forget lists configured rules and saved preferences, including unnamed or disconnected displays. Confirmation removes supported exact rules and matching preferences with backups and guarded reload recovery; active layout changes are possible. Dynamic or ambiguous rules are refused. Faulty geometry blocks unsafe layout actions without hiding healthy displays or workspace cards.
